_what: Per-host SEARCH DESCRIPTORS (M7 D3). One entry per host: where that store's product search lives, and whether its robots.txt lets us use it. Written by scripts/resolve_search_descriptors.py (off-clock, robots-first, >=2s throttle, 12-host cap), folded onto the rows of data/bh_gcc_sources.json by scripts/build_source_registry_data.py, and read at runtime behind ENABLE_SEARCH_DESCRIPTOR (default OFF).
_why_a_separate_file: Issue #94: a correction hand-written into the GENERATED registry file is erased by the next rebuild. This overlay is re-read on EVERY consolidation, so a rebuild preserves the resolver's work by construction rather than by discipline.
_why_per_host: B8 (2026-08-30) measured a per-PLATFORM search template as wrong ~40% of the time, and the dominant reason is robots.txt rather than markup: Shopify ships two default robots templates in the wild and the older one Disallows /search, which -- RFC 9309 matching being prefix-based -- kills BOTH the HTML search page and /search/suggest.json. Three 'Shopify' hosts on the 30-host panel block it and six do not. It also measured that 71 of the 95 live fragrance registry rows carry no mechanism at all, so each pays a platform probe on every cold compare for an answer that never changes.

_shape.url_template: absolute URL containing the literal {q}; empty for kind sitemap/none
_shape.robots_allowed: evaluated at resolution time with app/services/robots_eval.py under a NAMED agent token

_empty_on_purpose: Ships EMPTY, so the unit is dark twice over: the flag is off AND there is nothing to serve. Populate it with a real, throttled run -- python scripts/resolve_search_descriptors.py --from-registry --category fragrances --live -- and commit the result.
